carriers.description: For most of his naval career, Lt. Kyle Fringer has experienced naval operations from the inside of a P-8A Poseidon multi-mission maritime patrol and reconnaissance aircraft. His background as a naval flight officer (NFO) taught him to understand the mission from the air, where he provided ships, other aircraft, and even troops on the ground with actionable information and intelligence.
